task: Fix the AWS S3 client after AWS deprecated the path-style URL addressing for new buckets.

candidate_memories.content: S3 client is receiving 400 errors for new buckets created after December 2023; virtual-hosted addressing is required.
AWS S3 buckets created after December 2023 must use virtual-hosted addressing (bucket.s3.amazonaws.com).
The S3 client config must set force_path_style to false for all new bucket operations.
When AWS deprecates a URL style, audit all S3 client configurations before adding new bucket operations.
S3 client note (session 5): always set force_path_style=true for compatibility with older S3-compatible endpoints.
candidate_memories.notes: external_dependency_change: S3 path-style URL addressing deprecated for buckets created after December 2023

candidate_memories.content: Old S3 note says path-style addressing was required for compatibility with non-AWS S3 endpoints in the stack.
